products.title: Unroasted - Colombian Finca el Paraiso “Lychee peach” (Coffee of the Week)
products.body_html:
About the bean

93-Point Colombian Fruit Bomb

Bright red apple, juicy peach, pear, and soft caramel in a creamy, long-finishing cup. Diego Bermudez’s Lychee Peach is a washed Colombian that punches like a natural — thanks to a precise 36-hour anaerobic cherry fermentation, secondary microbe stage, and thermal shock that locks in the fruit. Malic acidity, silky body, and real consistency from a farm that treats processing like a science. High-scoring, high-impact, and built for coffee lovers who want something that stands out.

Grown at Finca El Paraíso in Cauca, Colombia by the Bermúdez brothers—Alex, Daniel, and Diego—this Castillo lot of is proof that relentless innovation pays off. 

Fruity complexion, highlighting red apple, peach, pear, and caramel.

NOTE: With its heady 93 points grade, this is The Highest scoring offering we have ever carried.

REGION: Cauca, Colombia
PRODUCER: Finca El Paraíso
PROCESS: Washed
ALTITUDE: 1,960 masl.
VARIETAL: Castillo
CUPPING SCORE: 93 points (a score of 80 points or above on a 100-point scale is graded "specialty")
BEST FOR: All brewing methods

ROAST RECOMMENDATION: Light to Medium.

Why This Filter Converts Better Water Into Better Drinks

Flojet Bottled Water System 5000 Series

Pump recipe-quality water from commercial bottles to ensure better tasting hot and cold beverages. The new 5000 Series Bottled Water System is designed to work with coffee / tea makers (Including Keurig) , refrigerator ice and water dispensers, espresso machines and portable sinks or any use requiring portable water. The 5000 series bottled water system is also designed for convenience. The pump automatically shuts off when the water source is depleted and restarts when water is restored. Its compact size supports easy mounting.

Details:

  • For Home & Commercial Appliances
  • Works with Tea / Coffee Machines, ice makers, refrigerators and more
  • Easy to use - new quick connect port fittings allow for fast installation and replacement of suction and discharge tubing.
  • Compact size for easy mounting
  • Float switch for automatic shut-off
  • Built-in check valve
  • Universal seal cap
  • Illuminated on / off switch
  • Long life motor, includes thermal overload protection to prevent overheating.
  • Diaphragm pump runs dry without damage.
  • Easy to use quick connect ports. Assemble system and connect in seconds.
  • Noise dampening rubber feet ensures quiet operation.

BWT Bestclear Water Filter & Softener System

Experience cleaner, softer, better-tasting water with the BWT Bestclear Water Filter & Softener System. Designed to improve water quality by reducing unwanted impurities and minimizing water hardness, this advanced water treatment system helps protect plumbing and water-using appliances from limescale buildup while delivering consistently high-quality water for everyday use.

Combining effective filtration and water-softening technology, the BWT Bestclear system helps reduce scale formation, supports appliance efficiency, and contributes to longer equipment life. It is an excellent solution for applications where water quality, reliability, and performance matter.

Key Benefits:

Water Filtration: Helps reduce targeted impurities and improve water quality, depending on the installed filter configuration.
Water Softening: Helps reduce hardness minerals that contribute to limescale buildup.
Appliance Protection: Helps minimize scale accumulation in compatible water-using equipment.
Consistent Performance: Supports dependable water quality for everyday or commercial applications, depending on the model.
Reliable Water Treatment: Combines filtration and softening in one integrated solution.
BWT Quality: Backed by BWT’s expertise in water treatment technology.
The BWT Bestclear Water Filter & Softener System is a smart choice for those seeking improved water quality, reduced limescale, and dependable water treatment in one solution.
